description: Data Atlas of Civil Society is an open data portal listed in Data Atlas of Civil Society, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bertelsmann Stiftung. The Civil Society Data Atlas is a central metadata portal that makes open data from civil society visible, findable and usable. The aim is to improve access to high-quality data, support the work of civil society organisations and promote data-based action. The data catalogue is at the heart of the Civil Society Data Atlas. Coverage: Germany. The European data portal lists 100 datasets from this catalogue. A multilingual title search (26 languages, transport, energy, water, digital and hazard words) found 6 datasets about infrastructure or natural hazards, catalogued as 6 records (collections of three or more datasets from one publisher or service host, and single datasets); the rest are outside the scope of this catalogue. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this country. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datenatlas-zg.
